channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Alvaro Dias anuncia que não será candidato ao Senado
item.description: Former senator Alvaro Dias (MDB) announced via an open letter that he will not run for a Senate seat in the 2026 elections. The politician opted not to seek re-election, ending his tenure in the Federal Senate after three terms.

item.title: Crusoé: Renato Bolsonaro declara patrimônio R$ 2,9 milhões menor ao TSE
item.description: Renato Bolsonaro, federal deputy candidate for PL-SP and brother of former President Jair Bolsonaro, told the TSE his wealth decreased by R$ 2.9 million over two years, now totaling R$ 268 thousand, mostly in financial applications. The disclosure includes a Banco do Brasil CDB but does not detail other holdings. The decline was attributed to asset devaluation, without specifying causes.

item.title: Caiado nega estar "batendo" em Flávio: "Não está sabendo se explicar"
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) denied attacking Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), stating that the senator is merely being held accountable for allegations against him, particularly regarding the R$ 61 million transfer from Banco Master to the film 'Dark Horse'. Caiado also criticized Flávio for questioning electronic voting machines, emphasizing his own democratic record of accepting electoral losses.

item.title: TSE rejeita pedido da Federação PT-PCdoB-PV para retirar vídeo em que Flávio associa Lula ao crime organizado
item.description: The TSE rejected the PT-PCdoB-PV Federation's request to remove a video by Flávio Bolsonaro linking Lula to organized crime, ruling that the claims were not proven false and fall within protected political speech. Minister Nunes Marques stated that electoral justice should not replace political debate and that content removal requires manifest illegality. The video remains online as it was made during pre-campaign without an explicit call to vote.

item.title: Patrimônio de Jaques Wagner cresce R$ 21,2 milhões em 8 anos
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner’s (PT-BA) assets grew by R$ 21.2 million between 2018 and 2026, rising from R$ 3.4 million to R$ 24.5 million — a 631% increase over eight years. He disclosed the figures to electoral authorities, and the data was published by the TSE in August 2026. Wagner is running for re-election in Bahia at an event with Lula, while under investigation by the Federal Police for alleged favoritism toward Banco Master.

item.title: “Minha candidatura é igual à música sertaneja”, diz Caiado
item.description: Former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) compared his presidential pre-candidacy to sertanejo music, saying that just as the genre faced initial prejudice before becoming widely popular, his campaign also began with resistance but is now gaining acceptance. He made the remark on Tuesday, the 3rd, in an interview published by O Antagonista.

item.title: ‘Novela Cleitinho’ termina sem ‘reviravolta da reviravolta’ e com o senador fora da disputa por MG
item.description: Senator Cleitinho Azevedo abandoned his bid for the Minas Gerais governorship in 2026 after the national directory of the Republicans party vetoed his candidacy, citing lost trust due to delayed decision-making and absence from the state convention. His withdrawal ends a prolonged political saga that demobilized the state's center-right, delaying a strong slate for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and aiding the PT, which is advancing Patrus Ananias for governor and Lulu for re-election in Minas Gerais.

item.title: Patrimônio de Jaques Wagner cresceu R$ 21 milhões em 8 anos. Veja os bens
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner's (PT-BA) assets grew by R$ 21.1 million between 2018 and 2026, rising from R$ 3.3 million to R$ 24.5 million, according to his TSE declaration. The increase is mainly due to credit from the sale of a property to Esporte Clube Bahia and Lagoons Empreendimentos SPE LTDA (R$ 13.8 million) and financial investments in BB funds and bonds. He declared six vehicles, an apartment in Salvador, and half a rural property in Andaraí (BA).

item.title: Após racha entre candidato de Zema e Aro por vaga na chapa em MG, PSD lança Carlos Viana ao Senado
item.description: The PSD officially nominated Carlos Viana for Senate re-election in Minas Gerais following a split with Marcelo Aro (PP), who had been expected to occupy the Senate spot on Governor Mateus Simões’ ticket. Aro, dissatisfied with Viana’s inclusion, was likened to Eduardo Cunha by Simões and is now being considered for a gubernatorial run or a spot on Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential ticket.

item.title: Republicanos avisa ao PL que 17 diretórios estaduais querem independência na corrida presidencial
item.description: Republicans informed the PL that 17 of its state directories support independence in the 2026 presidential election, while only nine favor an alliance with Flávio Bolsonaro. The party prioritizes electing federal deputies and senators to strengthen its congressional presence, while the PL seeks to secure Daniella Marques as Flávio’s running mate despite the senator being in a technical tie with Lula in polls. The PP has declared neutrality, limiting vice-presidential options for the Bolsonaro ticket.

item.title: Ao vivo: TSE desmonta urna eletrônica nesta 2ª feira
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) conducted a live disassembly of an electronic voting machine on Monday, August 3, 2026, at 5:30 PM, during the opening of the 1st National Week of the Electronic Voting System in Brasília. Led by Electoral Technology Coordinator Rafael Azevedo, the demonstration exposed key security components, including the motherboard, storage media for official voting software, and the encrypted vote recording module, aiming to enhance transparency and counter misinformation about Brazil’s electoral system.

item.title: TSE realiza sessão de abertura do segundo semestre forense na próxima segunda (3)
item.description: The TSE will hold the opening session of the second forensic semester of 2026 on Monday, the 3rd, at 7 p.m., broadcast live via Radio and TV Justice and the Tribunal’s YouTube channel. During the session, TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques will officially launch the National Week of the Electronic Voting System, aiming to inform the public about the security, transparency, and auditability of electronic voting machines, with the General Elections just 62 days away. The Tribunal will also review three-name lists for judicial vacancies in TRE-ES and TRE-PA, and two cases involving fines for illegal donations and electoral propaganda on common-use property, both reported by Minister Dias Toffoli.

item.title: Reunião com Republicanos para indicar vice foi mais um banho de água fria na campanha de Flávio Boslonaro
item.description: The meeting between Republicanos party leader Marcos Pereira, Flávio Bolsonaro, his campaign coordinator Rogério Marinho, and PL president Valdemar Costa Neto failed to yield the expected results, particularly regarding a vice-presidential nomination. Described as a 'cold shower,' the encounter reflected a lack of anticipated support or agreement. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Por que Flávio Bolsonaro ficará três dias sem agendas públicas nesta semana
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro will suspend public engagements until Wednesday to meet with Centrão parties and seek coalitions that could increase his propaganda time and secure a female-appealing running mate. His campaign will use the BTG/Nexus poll showing Lula’s lead narrowed to just four points (41% to 37%) to persuade centrist parties to back him in the first round, promising them privileged positions in a potential PL government.

item.title: Podemos resiste à indicação de sua presidente como vice de Flávio
item.description: National president of Podemos, federal deputy Renata Abreu (SP), is consulting state directories on whether to support her candidacy as vice-president on Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) ticket. The suggestion came from São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB), and the party has not yet officially decided its position in the 2026 presidential election.

item.title: Nunes Marques suspende condenação de ex-senador e permite candidatura
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Nunes Marques suspended the conviction of former senator Acir Gurgacz (PDT), allowing him to run in the 2026 elections, arguing the case should not have been reviewed by the STF as it was unrelated to his mandate. The decision follows the PGR’s opinion and was made due to the deadline for party conventions, despite Gurgacz having already served his sentence and the Clean Record Law normally barring him. This is his sixth criminal revision request, with four previously rejected and one pending appeal.

item.title: Tereza Cristina admite que chance de ser vice de Flávio “diminuiu bastante”
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP) said her chances of being the running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the 2026 presidential race have significantly decreased after the PP declared neutrality. However, she noted there is still time until August 5, the deadline for ticket registration, for the situation to be reassessed.

item.title: TSE promove exposição no Senado Federal na próxima quarta-feira (5)
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) will inaugurate the 'Caminho do Voto' exhibition next Wednesday (5) at the Federal Senate, showcasing the stages of Brazil’s electoral process, from electronic ballot machine development and testing to voting and vote tallying. Open to the press and public, the exhibition will remain at the Senador Ivandro Cunha Lima Space until March 7, then move to the Praça das Abelhas Space, where it will stay open until August 21. Part of the National Week of the Electronic Voting System, the exhibit aims to educate the public on the security, transparency, and integrity of Brazil’s electronic voting, recognized as one of the most secure democratic processes globally.

item.title: Dias após confirmar candidatura, Cleitinho desiste da disputa ao governo de MG
item.description: Senator Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos-MG) withdrew from the Minas Gerais gubernatorial race just days after announcing his candidacy, following a meeting with the party’s national leadership in Brasília. The decision was shared via a video on his social media. The move suggests a potential strategic realignment by the Republicans in Minas Gerais ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Flávio cogita estender busca por vice até o dia 15
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign has extended the deadline to select his vice-presidential running mate, initially set for August 5, now allowing a decision as late as August 15 — the final registration date with the TSE. The shift indicates a more cautious approach to choosing his ticket partner.

item.title: Fachin diz que críticas ao STF “fortalecem a democracia”
item.description: Supreme Court President Luiz Edson Fachin stated that criticism of the STF, when exercised within republican limits, strengthens democracy, as judicial activities resumed after the recess. He emphasized the need for harmony among the branches of government, referenced the Femicide Combat Pact, and congratulated Cristiano Zanin on his three-year tenure as a minister, highlighting his role in key rulings such as the conviction of former president Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Eleições 2026: íntegra do discurso de Renan Santos na convenção que o lançou candidato à Presidência
item.description: Renan Santos, businessman and founder of the Free Brazil Movement (MBL), officially launched his presidential candidacy at a convention of the Mission party. In his speech, he criticized President Lula (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), rejected the label of 'anti-Petista', framed his political journey as predestined, and controversially endorsed the idea of 'killing those who steal'.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral e AGU preparam diretrizes para IA nas eleições
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court and the AGU have signed a cooperation agreement to develop a practical guide on the ethical use of AI in the 2026 elections, aiming to increase transparency and reduce misinformation risks. The initiative follows the dissemination of an AI-generated video featuring former president Jair Bolsonaro endorsing his son, Flávio Bolsonaro, which intensified debate over 'positive deepfakes'. The publication, expected in August 2026, will be developed with the Electoral Judicial School and target public institutions, parties, candidates, and digital platforms.

item.title: Sem presença de Tarcísio, Republicanos faz convenção a portas fechadas
item.description: The Republicans party will hold a closed-door national convention in Brasília on Tuesday morning (August 4) to define its stance in the 2026 presidential election, without the presence of São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, who will attend a RedeTV! interview at the same time. The party is expected to adopt neutrality, allowing state directories to support candidates based on regional dynamics, with anticipated backing for Lula in Pernambuco and Flávio Bolsonaro in São Paulo. Daniella Marques, an administrator affiliated with the Republicans eyeing the vice-presidential slot, may lose party support if neutrality is confirmed.

item.title: Tereza Cristina afirma que ainda pode ser vice de Flávio Bolsonaro, apesar de veto do PP: 'Até a hora final tem espaço'
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) stated that, despite the Progressistas Party declaring neutrality in the 2026 presidential race and reducing her chances, she still sees a possibility of being chosen as vice-president on Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) ticket, emphasizing that 'there is still room until the final moment.' She noted her availability depends on the PP’s national leadership and acknowledged internal support for an alliance with the PL, but any change requires a decision from party president Ciro Nogueira. The PL officially nominated Flávio Bolsonaro on July 25 but has not yet announced his running mate, though he previously said she had accepted the invitation.

item.title: Zema deixa BH e se muda para São Paulo de olho na campanha
item.description: Minas Gerais Governor Romeu Zema (NOVO) announced his move to São Paulo to better coordinate his 2026 presidential campaign. He stated he has spent most of the last 90 days traveling across Brazil, especially in São Paulo, where the Novo party’s central directory is located. The relocation follows a trend among presidential candidates, including Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), who have established their main campaign structures in São Paulo.

item.title: Gracinha Caiado celebra 35 anos de casada com Caiado
item.description: Gracinha Caiado celebrated 35 years of marriage with former Goiás governor and presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado, during which she served as first lady of the state for eight years. The couple, who have two daughters, Maria and Marcela, appeared together at the official launch of his presidential campaign in São Paulo on July 26, 2026.

item.title: Escolha de vice complica Flavio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flavio Bolsonaro is struggling to choose his running mate for the 2026 elections, considering two women: Senator Tereza Cristina, who has strong agribusiness support and a positive image across sectors but lacks alignment with the Republicanos party; and Daniella Marques, his economic program coordinator, also from Republicanos but without party backing. The lack of agreement with Republicanos may force him to form a pure PL ticket, which would not provide meaningful political or electoral strength.

item.title: Flávio afirma que vai aceitar o resultado das urnas neste ano
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated in an interview on Band's Canal Livre program that he will accept the result of the 2026 presidential election, despite complaining about the lack of freedom in Brazil to discuss the topic. He emphasized the need to respect the electoral process, even amid restrictions on free speech.

item.title: STF tem de aceitar que decisões sejam contestadas pela opinião pública, diz Fachin
item.description: The president of the STF, Edson Fachin, stated that ministers should accept that their decisions on socially significant issues be debated and contested by public opinion, as such criticism strengthens democracy.

item.title: PF pede ao STF abertura de terceiro inquérito contra Lulinha e defesa diz que ele pode vir ao Brasil para depor
item.description: The Federal Police asked the STF to open a third investigation against Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), son of President Lula, for alleged influence peddling. The defense denies wrongdoing, states Lulinha is available to testify if needed, and claims the investigations are politically motivated to target the president, who is running for re-election in 2026. The two prior inquiries concern Lulinha’s links to intermediaries seeking contracts at the Health Ministry and Dataprev, including Antônio Camilo Antunes, suspected of diverting INSS funds.

item.title: ‘Eu disse não!’; ex-comandante da FAB revela em livro bastidores da crise que levou ao 8 de Janeiro
item.description: Lieutenant-Brigadier Carlos Baptista Junior, former commander of the Brazilian Air Force, reveals in his book 'Eu Disse Não' how he resisted pressures for an institutional coup during Bolsonaro’s government, detailing meetings at the Alvorada Palace and the Defense Ministry where a coup draft was discussed. He claims he helped prevent the Armed Forces from breaking institutional order, citing warnings from Army Commander Freire Gomes and the Navy’s Admiral Garnier’s willingness to support the plot, and his testimony was pivotal in the penal action that sentenced Bolsonaro to 27 years and three months in prison.

item.title: Fachin: decisões do STF podem ser contestadas pela opinião pública dentro de limites republicanos
item.description: Supreme Federal Court President Edson Fachin stated that the Court's decisions should naturally be debated and even contested by public opinion, but within republican limits. He emphasized that social tension with the judiciary does not weaken the institution but strengthens democracy, provided there is serenity and respect for democratic processes. Fachin refrained from directly addressing attacks by Javier Milei during the PL convention or mentioning the 2026 elections, focusing instead on improving procedural duration, decision clarity, and maintaining dialogue with society and other branches of government.

item.title: Desmistificando o Brasil
item.description: The text draws a parallel between Brazilian voter behavior in elections and football fans' reactions after a World Cup loss, arguing that both reflect structural criticism of the establishment rather than public ignorance. It contends that pre-2022 election polls showed growing rejection of both runoff candidates, proving the people had already said 'no' — implying the real flaws lie in the political system, media, and elite interests, not in the electorate's judgment.

item.title: Abertura da urna eletrônica entusiasma estudantes do Colégio Elefante Branco
item.description: Students from Colégio Elefante Branco participated in the opening of the 1st National Week of the Electronic Voting System, promoted by the TSE in Brasília, where they learned about the internal functioning of the electronic ballot box. The initiative, led by coordinator Rafael Azevedo, aimed to bring youth closer to Electoral Justice by demonstrating the system's transparency and security through the practical disassembly of the voting machine and explanation of its protective mechanisms.

item.title: Lulinha promete voltar ao Brasil se for chamado pelas autoridades
item.description: Lulinha, the eldest son of President Lula, says he is calm amid two Federal Police investigations against him and states he will return to Brazil if summoned by authorities. He currently lives in Madrid, Spain, with his family and was not surprised by the inquiries. The article is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: A metamorfose ambulante troca de pele
item.description: Former President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has two months until the 2026 election to persuade undecided Brazilian voters to join his coalition. He unveiled a preliminary government plan at the recent PT convention, aiming to broaden his base among converted supporters. The article emphasizes the challenge of overcoming voter indecision in a highly polarized political climate.

item.title: PF pede ao STF abertura de 3º inquérito contra Lulinha sob suspeita de tráfico de influência
item.description: The Federal Police has requested the Supreme Federal Court to open a third investigation against Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, son of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, on suspicion of influence peddling. The new inquiry aims to investigate alleged improper use of political influence to gain advantages in private business dealings.

item.title: A declaração de Lula que esquentou o debate sobre o seu herdeiro político
item.description: At the PT national convention in São Paulo, Lula suggested Fernando Haddad as his potential political heir, naming him first as a successor in 2030 after a possible term as São Paulo governor. He later mentioned other PT figures like Rafael Fonteles, Camilo Santana, and candidates from Pernambuco and Bahia, but the focus remained on Haddad, who received special prominence at the event. The statement sparked debate about the viability of this succession, particularly given the 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial race, where Haddad trails behind Tarcísio de Freitas.

item.title: Críticas ao STF fortalecem a democracia e não fragilizam a instituição, diz Fachin
item.description: Supreme Federal Court (STF) President Luiz Edson Fachin stated that republican criticism of the Court does not weaken it but strengthens democracy, emphasizing that the institution must be able to withstand questioning. He noted that the STF is continuously improving, focusing on efficiency, transparency, and dialogue with society and other branches, despite ongoing challenges. Fachin also highlighted initiatives such as technological investment, public sessions, and data production to enhance public trust in the Court.

item.title: Caiado diz ser 'agro raiz' e critica Flávio: 'Candidato sabor agro'
item.description: Presidential candidate and former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) declared himself the 'root' candidate of agribusiness and criticized Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), calling him 'agro flavor'. He positioned himself as the authentic representative of the agricultural sector in contrast to Bolsonaro's son.

item.title: PF pede abertura de terceiro inquérito contra Lulinha
item.description: The Federal Police requested the opening of a third inquiry against Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, the eldest son of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The request was made last week to the Supreme Federal Court, which will conduct a raffle to assign a rapporteur. Minister André Mendonça was recently involved in the proceedings, according to the source.

item.title: Lula, que promete ‘guerra’ às emendas, errou tudo na avaliação sobre o Congresso em 2022
item.description: Lula promised in 2022 to wage 'war' on parliamentary amendments and party funds, but failed to control the budget or stop the growth of these resources during his government. He also misjudged his ability to build good relations with Congress through dialogue and a strong allied base in the Chamber, as his coalition won just over 100 of the 513 seats, hindering legislative approval. These misjudgments in assessing his relationship with the Legislature contributed to governance challenges throughout his third term.

item.title: Crusoé: O embate entre Renan e Lula
item.description: President Lula and Renan Santos, candidate of the Mission party, attended their parties' conventions in São Paulo last weekend. Both are charismatic leaders with strong emotional ties to their supporters, but delivered radically opposing speeches, particularly regarding Lula’s rejection of the notion that social programs like Bolsa Família constitute 'alms', a core ideological divide in their confrontation.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: Flávio encurta distância para Lula
item.description: The latest BTG/Nexus poll shows that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has narrowed the gap with President Lula (PT) in voting intentions for the 2026 elections. The Meio-Dia em Brasília program also highlighted the confirmed candidacies of Lula for re-election, Renan Santos from the Missão party, and Michelle Bolsonaro, though her party was not specified in the excerpt.

item.title: Mulheres somam só 22,2% de representação em tribunais superiores
item.description: Women account for only 22.2% of ministers and councilors in Brazil's superior courts, despite being the majority of the population and holding nearly half of the initial judicial career positions. The progressive decline in female representation across the judicial hierarchy highlights the 'glass ceiling,' with only one woman (Cármen Lúcia) currently serving among the 11 justices of the STF. Judge Adriana Meireles Melonio attributes this disparity to historical and cultural barriers, as well as the disproportionate burden of domestic work.

item.title: Brancos são 83,8% dos magistrados e 89,5% no topo do Judiciário
item.description: White individuals constitute 83.8% of judges and 89.5% of appellate court judges in Brazil, highlighting significant racial inequality in the judiciary, particularly at higher levels. Despite racial quotas established by CNJ Resolution No. 203/2015, only 0.5% of active judges entered through this mechanism, and the judiciary’s low turnover slows progress toward diversity. The absence of Black women in the judiciary’s top ranks underscores a structural barrier to racial and gender equity.

item.title: Lula promete reforçar Defesa com 28% da verba livre da pasta bloqueada
item.description: Lula pledged to strengthen defense investments in a potential fourth term, stating that the BNDES will support the military industry more. However, 27.9% of the Defense Ministry’s discretionary and PAC funds—R$4.34 billion out of R$15.55 billion—remain blocked, nearly four times the executive average and 30.7% of the government’s total blockage. Although the Senate approved a R$2.5 billion advance for 2026 (to be repaid in 2027), the blockade continues, and the Defense Ministry must specify by August 6 which programs will be affected.

item.title: Zema anuncia mudança de BH para São Paulo para campanha presidencial: 'Alçar novos voos'
item.description: Romeu Zema announced he is moving from Belo Horizonte to São Paulo to advance his presidential campaign, spending more time in the state capital to engage with business leaders. He will also send some belongings to his hometown of Araxá to save on rent. Zema said he aims to 'reach new heights' in the election, following his party Novo's official nomination.

item.title: Lulinha, IA e até El Nino tiram clima de já ganhou do entorno de Lula
item.description: Despite leading in polls against Flávio Bolsonaro, the mood within Lula's circle is one of concern due to four factors: the potential use of AI for disinformation by the opposition, an investigation into his son Lulinha for influence peddling, the risk of El Niño-linked climate disasters damaging the government's image, and the possibility of foreign interference in the 2026 elections.
